sources.title: Nissan Global newsroom: All-new 3rd-generation Nissan LEAF press kit
sources.notes: Spec table lists usable capacity 52.9 kWh (130 kW motor) and 75.1 kWh (160 kW motor) for the global LEAF; text says select models have 52 kWh usable, larger 75 kWh also available. Global (not Canada-specific) page.

sources.title: Nissan USA newsroom: 2026 Nissan LEAF press kit
sources.notes: US S+/SV+/Platinum+ all list a 75 kWh liquid-cooled lithium-ion pack (usable not stated on this page); up to 150 kW; 10-80% about 35 min.

battery.capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Nissan global press kit spec table: 75.1 kWh usable for the larger (160 kW motor) LEAF pack. US press kit says the S+ has a 75 kWh pack with a 214 hp (160 kW) motor, so the Canadian S+ is taken to be the same pack; the global page is not Canada-specific.
Nissan global press kit spec table: 75.1 kWh usable for the 75 kWh LEAF pack. US press kit (src-nissan-usa-leaf-press-kit-2026) lists 75 kWh for SV+ as well; Canadian SV+ assumed identical.
Nissan global press kit spec table: 75.1 kWh usable for the 75 kWh LEAF pack. US press kit lists 75 kWh for Platinum+ as well; Canadian Platinum+ assumed identical.

Estimated (owner to confirm the scaling basis): GM's 2026 spec guide gives no kWh figure, only pack module counts (4WT Standard Range 14, 5WT Extended 20, 8WT Maximum 24). InsideEVs (src-insideevs-silverado-battery) reports 204 kWh usable for the 24-module pack: 204 x 14/24 = 119.

dc_max_kw.notes: GM 2026 Silverado EV WT spec guide, Charging Specifications (pdftotext, columns 4WT/5WT/8WT): Standard Range '475 volt, up to 220 kW', Extended '670 volt, up to 300 kW', Maximum '800 volt, up to 350 kW'. Corrects the earlier 350 kW value, which belongs to the Max pack only.

battery.nominal_voltage_class.notes: GM spec guide: Standard Range pack '475 volt'. 475 V is the max charge voltage, not a nominal voltage; mapped to the 400v class (800 V x 14/24 = 467 V supports it). Corrects the earlier 800v value, which belongs to the Max pack.

battery.capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated (owner to confirm the scaling basis): LT Standard Range inferred to share the 14-module WT Standard Range pack (no cited page says so; EPA 283 mi vs WT 286 mi). GM spec guide gives no kWh; 204 kWh usable (24-module pack, InsideEVs) x 14/24 = 119.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: GM WT spec guide gives 'up to 220 kW' for the Standard Range pack; LT Standard Range inferred to share that pack (not stated by any cited page). Corrects the earlier 350 kW value (Max pack).

battery.nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: GM WT spec guide lists the Standard Range pack as '475 volt' (max charge voltage, mapped to 400v class); LT Standard Range inferred to share the pack. Corrects the earlier 800v value (Max pack).
